lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white stripe segments are visible across the lateral torso. The spacing is relatively periodic, with an average inter-stripe gap of approximately 30 to 45 pixels at the mid-lateral height.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A distinct Y-shaped bifurcation is observed on the third stripe from the anterior edge, where the line splits into two branches in the ventral third of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 4th and 5th stripes from the anterior show clear discontinuities, existing as dashed segments. The 11th and 12th stripes are abbreviated, terminating in the upper dorsal region and not extending to the mid-lateral line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of approximately 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, immediately anterior to the hind limb insertion.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-posterior haunch align on a horizontal axis, forming a short geometric line segment roughly parallel to the ventral line.

other_distinctive_markers: A singular white spot is visible on the lateral surface of the muzzle, anterior to the eye. High-contrast white transverse bands are present on the carpals of the forelimbs and the tarsus of the visible hind limb.
